name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt **Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct** as EXCAVA’s primary reasoning engine. It outperforms other open models on complex tasks while staying cost-efficient—proven in our last benchmark. Trade-off: it’s heavier than smaller models, so we’ll cap context length to keep latency under control.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct’s stability won’t bridge EXCAVA’s ceiling—it’s still 0.5% short of the jump we need. Drop it and test **Claude Mythos 5** instead; if it hits the 0.5% mark in the next benchmark, we adopt it—no cap, no excuses.
